test_summary.source_contract_tests: targeted subset of present JSON Schema keywords, not complete Draft 2020-12 compliance

findings.title: INCALL sender/authority claim not authentically bound by schema
findings.remedy: Verify actual GitHub author and canonical issue against authorized team map; ignore claimed sender status and authority

findings.title: ACCEPTED work status can coexist with NOT_RUN evidence
findings.remedy: Require exact SHA gate receipts and legitimate Head decision for acceptance; reject impossible status/evidence pairs

findings.title: Work-item schema excludes mandatory contract metadata
findings.remedy: Model contract fields scope, role, risk, prereqs, budget, repairs and Head decision then enforce limits

findings.title: Message IDs, SHA and URLs too permissive
findings.remedy: Canonical identifiers, SHA/UNKNOWN semantics, URL validation, replay binding

findings.title: No size limits in message schemas
findings.remedy: Max string length, bounded evidence count and safe URI policies

findings.title: 23 branches report protected:false; separate runner trust exposure
findings.path: Repository branch metadata, not PrismCell executable
findings.remedy: Review permissions and actual protections; do not send unreviewed source to owner runners

findings.title: No real INCALL exchange or template exact-SHA CI verified
findings.remedy: Portable schema regression, real validator and authorized sample intake trial

findings.title: Workcell adoption lacks exact template source manifest
findings.remedy: Pin template SHA and schema digest per workcell, test migration

findings.title: Blue legacy branch includes product source snapshot and three workflows
findings.remedy: Never broad merge agent branches; preserve selective source promotion
